scope: Cargo default-feature dependency resolution for launcher and session, including build dependencies and excluding dev-only dependency edges; this is a conservative source inventory, not proof of code linked in each binary.
collection: Collected from cached registry packages via cargo metadata --locked --offline --filter-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. Non-Linux targets were not downloaded or inspected. License texts retain their original upstream content.
limitations: Native dependencies compiled or linked by build scripts may require additional source notices.
License expressions and collected notices have not been independently audited for legal completeness.
Upstream source download URLs and Cargo registry checksums identify exact crate archives; an offline vendor-source archive is not included.
